# Double the pull

<!-- STEP id="time" -->
Release the cart at the start line, and time it until it reaches the pipe. Call this time T1. Double the mass in the cup, and time the cart again: T2. T2 is shorter.

The distance is the same both times. So from s = 1/2 a T², a1 / a2 = T2² / T1².

<!-- STEP id="larger" -->
With the larger force, the acceleration is larger. It is a little less than double, because friction acts on the wheels of the cart.
